title: Consolidation: The Language Reform & the Politics of Hungarian

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can recount the history of the Hungarian Language Reform from 1784 to 1844 with accurate cultural and linguistic terminology.
I can construct possessive and postpositional nominalization chains (-ás/-és) fluently.
I can form and deploy abstract nouns (-ság/-ség) in analytical and historical prose.
